author: same assistant
text: Workshop analysis: R already funds Libyan cooperation, a public update and protected two-way outreach for victims, witnesses, affected communities and representatives inside and outside Libya. Retain that channel; request the missing line-by-line update on all four inquiries. Maintaining outreach and reporting needs staff and witness-privacy safeguards; narrower outreach costs less but risks selectivity. These recommendations do not establish Brazilian endorsement of R or a future vote.
